items.question: Within how many days does this retailer credit a refund to a card, bank account, PayPal or Tabby account after checking a returned item collected by courier?
items.fact: Card, bank, PayPal or Tabby refunds credited within 4-15 days.

items.question: What two items must you bring when returning products to a store in person?
items.gold: The products in their original shipping packaging and your invoice.
items.fact: Store returns require original shipping packaging and invoice.
